This course is designed for developers who already understand basic JavaScript and want to become confident, job\-ready backend engineers. You will move step by step from intermediate concepts to advanced production\-level backend systems using Node.js and Express.js.

By the end of this program, you will be able to design, build, secure, test, and deploy scalable backend applications used in real\-world products.

What You Will Learn1\. Core Backend Foundations

* How backend architecture works
* Understanding client\-server communication
* HTTP methods, status codes, headers
* REST API design principles
* MVC architecture pattern
* Clean code structure for scalable apps

You will build structured and maintainable server\-side applications from day one.

2\. Deep Dive into Node.js

* Event loop and non\-blocking architecture
* Modules system (CommonJS vs ES Modules)
* Streams and buffers
* File system operations
* Error handling best practices
* Performance optimization techniques

You will understand how Node.js actually works under the hood, not just how to use it.

3\. Express.js Professional Level

* Advanced routing patterns
* Middleware architecture
* Custom middleware creation
* Request validation and sanitization
* Global error handling
* API versioning strategy

You will learn how to structure production\-grade Express applications.

4\. Database Mastery

* MongoDB with Mongoose (advanced schema design)
* PostgreSQL with Sequelize or Prisma
* Indexing and query optimization
* Data relationships and aggregation pipelines
* Transactions and ACID concepts
* Database performance tuning

You will learn how to design databases that scale.

5\. Authentication and Security

* JWT authentication (access and refresh tokens)
* Role\-based access control
* OAuth integration
* Password hashing with bcrypt
* Rate limiting and brute\-force protection
* CORS configuration
* Secure API design principles
* OWASP security best practices

You will learn how to build secure backend systems used in real applications.

6\. Advanced API Development

* Pagination, filtering, sorting
* File uploads with Multer
* Email and SMS integration
* Payment gateway integration
* API documentation with Swagger
* GraphQL fundamentals
* WebSockets and real\-time applications

You will move beyond CRUD and build dynamic, real\-time systems.

7\. Testing and Code Quality

* Unit testing with Jest
* Integration testing
* API testing
* Mocking and stubbing
* Code coverage
* Debugging strategies
* Logging with Winston or Morgan

You will write backend code that is reliable and production\-ready.

8\. DevOps and Deployment

* Environment configuration
* Docker basics for backend
* CI/CD fundamentals
* Deploying to VPS
* Deploying to AWS
* Using PM2 for process management
* Reverse proxy with Nginx

You will learn how to take your backend from local machine to live server.

9\. Microservices and Advanced Architecture

* Monolith vs Microservices
* Service\-to\-service communication
* Message queues (Redis, RabbitMQ)
* Caching strategies
* Load balancing concepts
* Horizontal scaling
* API Gateway pattern

You will understand how large\-scale systems are built.

10\. Performance and Scalability

* Memory management
* Clustering in Node.js
* Handling high traffic APIs
* Database indexing strategy
* Caching with Redis
* Profiling and monitoring

You will be able to optimize applications for real\-world traffic.

Projects You Will Build

* Authentication system with roles and permissions
* E\-commerce backend API
* Real\-time chat application
* Production\-ready REST API with full testing
* Microservice\-based backend architecture

Each project is designed to simulate real client requirements.

Who This Course Is For

* Developers who know basic JavaScript
* Frontend developers who want to become full\-stack
* Junior backend developers who want to level up
* Freelancers who want to build scalable APIs

Outcome

After completing this course, you will:

* Build secure and scalable backend systems
* Write production\-quality Node.js and Express.js code
* Design APIs used in enterprise\-level applications
* Confidently deploy and maintain backend services
* Be ready for backend developer roles

title: Contractual || Senior Recruiter - Talent Acquisition - Robotics Labs New
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

**Senior Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist**
----------------------------------------------------


**Experience**: Minimum 4 years  

**Location**: Koramangala, Bangalore  

**Work Mode**: In\-office  

**Work Schedule**: Its Tuesday to Saturday working, Sunday\-Monday are the week off



Contractual role for 6 months.


### **About the Role**



We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on Senior Recruiter to lead and execute high\-volume hiring initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in bulk hiring, hiring drive management, and the ability to manage and mentor HR interns while working closely with business and operations teams.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Plan, organize, and execute large\-scale hiring drives (virtual and on\-ground).
* Manage bulk hiring for Operations and other frontline roles.
* Lead and manage a team of HR interns, including task allocation, training, and daily performance tracking.
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment processes: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding coordination.
* Will be managing a team of HR interns
* Design and roll out attractive and effective employee referral bonus programs to boost hiring outcomes.
* Leverage AI\-based recruitment tools and modern sourcing techniques to improve hiring efficiency (preferred).
* Collaborate closely with hiring managers to understand manpower needs, timelines, and priorities.
* Maintain recruitment data, dashboards, and hiring reports for leadership review.

Ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.  
* 

### **Required Qualifications \& Skills**


* Minimum 4 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.
* Strong experience in bulk hiring and hiring drive management, especially for Operations / Sales etc
* Proven experience in managing and mentoring HR interns or junior recruiters.
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms and recruitment tools; exposure to AI hiring tools is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and execute lucrative referral programs.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

### **Why Join Us**


* High ownership role with end\-to\-end hiring responsibility
* Opportunity to lead and build a recruitment team
* Fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Direct exposure to leadership and strategic hiring decisions
* Competitive compensation, perks like commute, food
**Our Values**


* **Empathy, Trust \& Candor**  

We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* **Bias for Action**  

We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* **Always Be Learning**  

We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* **Act Like an Owner**  

We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**



Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!



Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.



Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.  

  

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey! **About the role:**  

We are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to oversee and manage the financial operations of our company. Calfus is headquartered in the US and has India operations in Pune and Bangalore and a subsidiary in Canada. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in financial planning, analysis, and decision\-making to ensure the company's financial health and long\-term growth. **What You’ll Do:**  

Financial Planning \& Analysis: \-
* Develop and manage budgets, forecasts, and financial models.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities to optimize costs.
* Provide actionable insights to support strategic decision\-making.

  



Business Partnering: \-
* Baseline key cost levers and collaborate with leaders to establish benchmarks for assisting in pricing, contract structuring, and margin analysis for large deals **including project profitability and profit margin.**
* Collaborate with delivery, sales, HR and other teams to support cross\-functional initiatives.

  



Accounting \& Compliance: \-
* Oversee day\-to\-day accounting operations, including accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and general ledger.
* Spearhead month end, quarter end and year end activities including accruals \& monthly analysis on the actuals vs provisions.
* Ensure compliance with India, US and Canadian tax regulations and financial reporting standards including coordination with auditors for periodic and annual audits.

  



Cash Flow \& Risk Management: \-
* Monitor and manage cash flow to ensure liquidity and operational efficiency.
* Identify financial risks and implement mitigation strategies.

  



Stakeholder Communication: \-
* Prepare and present financial reports to senior management and **closely work with C\-suite and top management directly**
* Collaborate with practice heads to align financial goals with business objectives.

Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit. **Calfus Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer:**

title: HR Specialist, Global Operations
description:
**About Command\|Link**

  

Command\|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command\|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command\|Link was recognized as the SD\-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT\&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command\|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

  

Learn more about us here!

 **This is a 100% remote position!**

 **About your new role:**


We’re looking for a detail\-oriented and resourceful HR Specialist to support our growing global workforce across multiple countries. This role plays an important part in ensuring smooth day\-to\-day HR operations for international employees and contractors engaged through global partners and internal HR systems.

  

You’ll work closely with the Director of HR to maintain compliant, organized, and efficient HR processes across regions. This is an operationally focused role for someone who brings structure to fast\-moving environments. While processes exist, priorities can shift quickly, and the right person will be comfortable operating in a growing, startup\-style organization where adaptability, ownership, and responsiveness are essential.

  

Beyond supporting existing processes, you’ll help monitor and strengthen HR automation workflows, identify inefficiencies, and contribute ideas that improve speed, accuracy, and scalability. We’re looking for someone with a systems\-oriented mindset who is comfortable leveraging modern tools, including AI, to enhance productivity and drive smarter HR operations.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a primary HR contact for international employees and contractors, including those engaged through EOR service providers.
* Support onboarding logistics, documentation management, and new hire coordination across HR systems and EOR platforms.
* Maintain and organize employee personnel files, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and proper record retention.
* Assist with drafting offer letters and routing approvals through established workflows.
* Monitor HRIS automated workflows to ensure processes are running properly, troubleshoot issues, and recommend improvements.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes through automation, AI tools, and system enhancements.
* Support employee benefits coordination and related documentation, including inquiries routed through EOR providers.
* Support time\-off tracking and policy administration.
* Maintain and update HR documentation, knowledge base resources, and organizational reporting (e.g., org charts).
* Track employment law updates in countries where we operate and coordinate with EOR partners as needed.
* Provide recruiting coordination support on an as\-needed basis (e.g., scheduling assistance, posting documentation).
* Assist in planning and coordinating local team\-building initiatives and employee engagement activities within regional teams.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned to support the HR function and broader organization.
* Takes on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support the success of the team and organization.

 **What you'll need for success:**

* 2–4 years of experience in Human Resources or People Operations.
* Experience supporting international employees through EOR service providers (e.g., Deel) preferred.
* Exposure to multi\-country workforce operations and global compliance considerations.
* Foundational knowledge of HR compliance and employment law.
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g., Rippling) and comfort navigating multiple systems.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills.
* Process\-driven mindset with the ability to follow structured workflows while thinking critically about improvements.
* Strong sense of data integrity, confidentiality, and discretion when handling sensitive employee information.
* Comfort using technology to improve efficiency, with curiosity around automation and AI\-driven tools.
* Resourceful, creative problem\-solver who can think beyond “how it’s always been done.”
* Strong written communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

 **Why you'll love life at Command\|Link**


Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

* Room to grow at a high\-growth company
* An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
* Your work will have a tangible impact
* Flexible time off
* Fun events at cool locations
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

  

At CommandLink, we’re committed to creating a fair, consistent, and efficient hiring experience. As part of our process, we use AI\-assisted tools to help review and analyze applications. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.

  

AI tools are used only to assist in the evaluation process — they do not make final hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting or hiring team before any decisions are made.

	+ A proven track record of troubleshooting issues and initiating small\-scale projects to streamline workflows.
	+ Ability to exercise discretion, sound judgment, and diplomacy when communicating with everyone from new hires to Senior Management.

title: Role - Robotics Arm - Mechanical
description:
Please find the below details for your ref

**Role** \- Mechanical Design Engineer \- Robotic Arm

**Location**: Bangalore South (**Jigani**)

**Work mode**: On\-site (preferred) / Hybrid (as applicable)

**Experience**: 1 – 5 years (Max)

**Domain**: Industrial Robotics / Autonomous Manipulation

**Company Overview:**

Rx100 Ventures is a sector\-focused deep tech venture firm headquartered in Bangalore, India. We partner with startups at the intersection of industrial innovation, deep tech, and digital transformation, providing capital and strategic direction to accelerate their growth.

**About the Role**

We’re building an Autonomous Industrial Robotic Arm in the 5–7 DOF range with payload \<250 kg and hiring a Mechanical Design Engineer to take hardware from concept → CAD → prototype → validation → production release. This is a hands\-on role focused on precision mechanisms and joint module engineering, not general CAD drafting.

**What You’ll Do** 

· Design arm joints, links, housings/covers, and end\-effector mechanical interfaces for a multi\-DOF industrial arm

· Own joint module design: BLDC motor \+ harmonic/planetary gearbox integration, bearing/shaft/fastener sizing, housing architecture, sealing (IP\-rated where required), thermal paths/heat sinking, and robust cable routing/strain relief

· Create production\-grade engineering drawings: GD\&T, datums, fits, tolerance stack\-ups, and release packs (BOM \+ rev control)

· Support prototype builds and iteration cycles: assembly debugging, RCA, fixture/jig requirements, reliability improvements

· Drive DFM/DFA with suppliers (machining, sheet metal, castings, heat\-treat, surface finishing), RFQs, and drawing clarifications

· Collaborate with controls/electronics/firmware teams on packaging constraints, sensor mounts, and mechatronic interfaces.

**Must\-Have Requirements** 

· 1 plus years of mechanical design experience in robotics / industrial automation / precision machinery / mechatronics

· Strong fundamentals: mechanisms, materials, manufacturing, fits \& tolerances

· Proficiency in 3D CAD \+ drawings

· CAD: Autodesk Fusion 360 / Autodesk Inventor and/or SolidWorks / Creo / NX

· Drawings: GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, datum strategy

· Experience with actuator \& transmission integration: motors/gearboxes, bearings, shafts, housings, fasteners

**Good\-to\-Have** 

· Experience with robot arms (5–7 axis), heavy/industrial manipulators, or servo\-driven jointed mechanisms

· Familiarity with harmonic drive / planetary gearbox / cycloidal concepts, encoder integration, lubrication, serviceability

· Working knowledge of FEA/CAE (e.g., ANSYS or equivalent) for stiffness/deflection and basic modal checks

· Exposure to IP sealing, thermal management around motors/drives, and production validation practices

**This Role Is NOT For**

Profiles limited to 2D drafting or architecture/interiors/civil CAD

Pure simulation\-only roles without ownership of mechanical design deliverables

Freshers / interns

ROS / ROS2 development

Move It, Gazebo\-based simulation work

SLAM or autonomous navigation systems

Computer Vision implementation

AI / ML\-centric roles

Pure software engineering roles

Simulation\-only responsibilities without physical product ownership

title: Community Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Calyp is a deep\-tech startup, based in Germany, building next\-generation human–computer interaction products at the intersection of brain–computer interface (BCI), consumer technology, and Augmented Reality (AR).

We are transitioning from a research\-focused phase into a consumer\-facing brand, and we are looking for someone who can help us grow a lively, authentic, and engaging online community around our story, products, and vision.

This role is best suited for someone who enjoys creating content, interacting with people online, and thinking like a digital community builder rather than a traditional marketer.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Community \& Social Presence Builder who loves the internet culture of content, conversations, and creator\-driven growth.

This is a hands\-on, early\-stage startup role where you will have the freedom to experiment, build your creative style, and directly shape how people see and interact with Calyp online.

If you are someone who already creates content, enjoys social media trends, tech enthusiast or wants to grow as a digital creator, this role will feel natural to you.

**What You Will Do**

**Community Building \& Engagement**

* Grow and energise Calyp’s presence on platforms such as LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Discord, and other relevant communities
* Actively engage with followers, comments, and discussions
* Help build a positive, curious, and vibrant community around technology and innovation
* Moderate and participate in community conversations

**Content \& Creator\-Style Storytelling**

* Ideate and create engaging posts, reels, and short\-form content
* Create engaging content around tech, startups and innovation
* Think in terms of hooks, storytelling, and shareable ideas
* Support launch campaigns, product updates, and founder insights
* Maintain a consistent but human and authentic brand voice

**Community Communication \& Updates**

* Help prepare newsletters and updates
* Coordinate content from research, product, and founder teams

**Basic Marketing \& Outreach Support**

* Prepare simple marketing materials (presentations, one\-pagers, outreach messages)
* Assist with simple CRM or lead coordination (training will be provided)

**Who We Are Looking For**

* Someone genuinely excited about social media, communities, and online conversations
* Creator mindset \> corporate marketing mindset
* Comfortable using Instagram, X, and LinkedIn
* Good written communication skills in English
* Self\-driven and reliable

*No prior corporate experience is required.*

**Big Plus If You**

* Create content on any platform (influencer, creator, or hobby page is fine)
* Have managed a brand, club, or community page before
* Understand engagement psychology — hooks, trends, and audience interaction
* Are curious about startups, technology, or innovation culture

**What You Get**

* Ownership of social and community presence for a growing startup
* Direct mentorship from founders
* Freedom to experiment creatively
* Opportunity to grow into a higher responsibility and compensation role as Calyp scales

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

* Your LinkedIn profile
* Links to social media pages or content you have created or managed
* Have you managed or contributed to an online community (Discord, Slack, Facebook Group, etc.)? \[Yes / No]

title: HR Officer
description:
Garage.app is an AI\-powered SaaS and entrepreneurship platform. We move fast, operate lean, and expect people to own outcomes—not wait for instructions.

We are hiring an independent, sharp, no\-hand\-holding HR Off**icer** who can run HR end\-to\-end and keep pace with a startup that builds, hires, and iterates continuously.

**What You Will Own** 

**HR Operations (End\-to\-End Ownership)**

* Run complete employee lifecycle: onboarding → documentation → confirmations → exits
* Create, implement, and enforce HR policies (not just file them)
* Maintain compliance, statutory filings, and HR hygiene without follow\-ups

**Leave \& Attendance Management** 

· Own end\-to\-end leave management: policy enforcement, approvals, tracking, and reporting

· Monitor attendance, late logins, absenteeism, and misuse of leave

· Ensure leave data is accurate, transparent, and aligned with payroll

· Act early on patterns impacting productivity or discipline

**Hiring \& Talent Execution**

* Drive hiring coordination across tech, product, business, and interns
* Screen candidates, schedule interviews, close offers—fast and clean
* Work with founders, recruiters, and agencies to meet hiring timelines

**People, Performance \& Discipline**

* Track attendance, leaves, performance cycles, and reviews
* Flag people risk early—performance gaps, attrition, morale issues
* Ensure accountability across teams without micromanagement

**Culture \& Startup Reality**

* Be the first line of clarity, not escalation
* Handle employee issues with maturity, discretion, and firmness
* Help build a performance\-first, no\-nonsense culture

**What We Expect (Non\-Negotiable)**

* Strong bias for action—things move because of you
* Comfortable working directly with founders
* Clear communicator who can say “no” when needed
* Can manage confidential matters without drama
* Thrives in ambiguity and pressure

**You are Likely Succeed If You Have**

* 2–5 years as an HR Generalist / HR Ops professional
* Startup, SaaS, tech, or consulting experience
* Solid working knowledge of Indian labour laws \& compliance
* Experience hiring tech/product roles is a strong plus

**Why This Role Is a Career Accelerator**

* Direct exposure to founders and decision\-making
* Real ownership—not a support role
* High learning velocity in an AI\-first startup ecosystem

**Apply only if** you’re ready to move fast, take responsibility, and operate independently.

title: AD- Resource Management
description:
**Our potential, unleashed.** 




 India’s impact on the global economy has increased at an exponential rate and Deloitte presents an opportunity to unleash and realize your potential amongst cutting edge leaders, and organizations shaping the future of the region, and indeed, the world beyond.
 



 At Deloitte, your whole self to work, every day. Combine that with our drive to propel with purpose and you have the perfect playground to collaborate, innovate, grow, and make an impact that matters.
 



  





**The Team:** 




 The Resource management team in Deloitte India helps with the process of staffing client projects with appropriate available staff who have the right skill. It involves the process of planning, scheduling, and allocating practitioners to maximize project efficiency. The team helps monitor variances between planned vs. scheduled vs. actuals and increase utilization by optimizing the available capacity.
 



  





**Your work profile.** 




**Primary purpose of the role:** 




 We are looking for an experienced workforce management/resource management professional with 10\+ years of experience, preferably in the Audit business space with an understanding of the audit project lifecycle and related compliance requirements. The ideal candidate will be responsible for effectively managing staff allocation, capacity planning, bench and utilization to support audit engagements and assurance services. This role requires strong leadership skills, excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead and manage resource planning, allocation, and forecasting for Audit and Assurance teams to ensure optimal utilization and timely delivery of audit engagements.
* Collaborate with audit managers and partners to understand staffing needs, project timelines, and skill requirements.
* Monitor resource availability, skills inventory, and capacity to proactively identify gaps and recommend hiring or training initiatives.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports on resource utilization, productivity, and project status for senior management.
* Coordinate with HR and recruitment teams to support talent acquisition and onboarding for audit professionals.
* Facilitate workforce planning discussions to align audit demand with resource supply and business objectives.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, audit standards, and regulatory requirements related to staffing and resource management.
* Drive process improvements in resource scheduling, allocation, and performance tracking.
* Manage and mentor a team of resource coordinators or analysts, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance environment.



**Required Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field; MBA.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in resource management within an Audit and Assurance environment, with overall 10\+ years' experience in Resource Management.
* Strong knowledge of audit methodologies, assurance standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast\-paced setting.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in resource management tools, project management software, and MS Office Suite.
* Experience with workforce planning, capacity management, and reporting.



**Preferred Skills:** 



* Experience working in Big Four or large audit firms.
* Familiarity with emerging technologies in audit (e.g., data analytics, automation).
* Strong leadership and team development capabilities.



  





**Location and way of working** 




 · Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata
 



 · Hybrid is our default way of working.
 







**How you’ll grow** 




***Connect for impact***





 Our exceptional team of professionals across the globe are solving some of the world’s most complex business problems, as well as directly supporting our communities, the planet, and each other. Know more in our Global Impact Report and our India Impact Report.
 



***Empower to lead***





 You can be a leader irrespective of your career level. Our colleagues are characterized by their ability to inspire, support, and provide opportunities for people to deliver their best and grow both as professionals and human beings. Know more about Deloitte and our One Young World partnership.
 



***Inclusion for all***





 At Deloitte, people are valued and respected for who they are and are trusted to add value to their clients, teams and communities in a way that reflects their own unique capabilities. Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive. At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.
 



***Drive your career***





 At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. We recognize there is no one size fits all career path, and global, cross\-business mobility and up / re\-skilling are all within the range of possibilities to shape a unique and fulfilling career. Know more about Life at Deloitte.
 



**Everyone’s welcome… entrust your happiness to us** 





 Our workspaces and initiatives are geared towards your 360\-degree happiness. This includes specific needs you may have in terms of accessibility, flexibility, safety and security, and caregiving. Here’s a glimpse of things that are in store for you.
 



**Interview tips** 





 We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared, confident, and comfortable. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research, know some background about the organization and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

description:
**Job Title: HR Manager** 




**Location: Pune** 




**Experience Required:** 
 2\-5 years
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resource
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 The HR Manager is responsible for overseeing all aspects of human resources practices and processes. This role plays a key part in developing HR strategies aligned with the company’s goals, managing recruitment and employee relations, ensuring compliance with employment laws, and fostering a positive workplace culture that drives performance and engagement.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* 2–5 years of experience in Human Resources
* Strong knowledge of HR Management, Employee Relations, and HR Policies
* Hands\-on experience in HR Operations and end\-to\-end HR processes
* Strong knowledge of payroll management and payroll services
* Good understanding of labor laws and statutory compliance
* Working knowledge of PF, ESIC, PT deductions, and other statutory compliances and payroll\-related regulations
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative team environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred)
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills \& Ability to work collaboratively in a team.



  





 Job description
 



 • Manage the complete recruitment process from sourcing stage right through to offer stage and develop innovative strategies to attract diverse candidates.
 



 • Work with hiring managers to provide guidance, expertise, collaboration and teamwork to hire the best talent for our teams. Own the Internship \& other Graduate programs.
 



 • Manage HR operations including documentation, payroll processing, attendance and compliances.
 



 • Create training programs to upskill and enhance productivity.
 



 • Design and implement employee engagement initiatives like talent reviews, benefits, policies, on\-boarding programs, induction etc. across the organization.
 



 • Manage appraisal process with the support of team leads and advise management on the same
 



 • Develop the processes and run it through the company
 



 • Manage employees operating in multiple cities in India, report to the CEO directly
 



 • Actively use social media channels like Linkedin to create corporate brand recall and attract candidates.
 



 • Develop and implement HR strategies and initiatives aligned with the overall business strategy.
 



 • Plan and conduct performance management reviews periodically across the organization.
 



 • Support current and future business needs through the development, engagement, motivation and retention of human capital.
 



 • Advise the business with need\-based solutions on employee matters.
 



  





 Key Skills\-
 


* Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
* Employee Engagement \& Employee Relations
* HR Operations \& Administration
* Performance Management \& Appraisal Reviews
* Compensation \& Benefits Management
* Payroll Management \& Statutory Compliance
* Labor Law Compliance (PF, ESIC, PT \& other statutory deductions)
* Policy Development \& Implementation
* HR Documentation \& Process Optimization

 On\-site (New Town, Kolkata)
 



**Education:** 
  Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
 



**Experience:** 

 Intermediate/Specialist (3–5 years)

* Understand manpower requirements from department heads
* Prepare and post job descriptions on job portals and social platforms
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers
* Conduct HR round interviews
* Coordinate offer letters, salary discussions (as per approved structure), and joining formalities
* Ensure positions are closed within defined timelines

* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and other employment documents
* Collect and verify employee documents
* Conduct induction and orientation programs
* Explain company policies, culture, and code of conduct

* Maintain accurate monthly attendance and leave records
* Coordinate with finance for timely and error\-free salary processing
* Manage leave balances and approvals as per policy

* Coordinate goal\-setting process with managers
* Track monthly/quarterly performance reviews
* Maintain performance documentation
* Support managers in handling underperformance cases

* Work closely with department heads for hiring and performance matters

title: QA Engineer
description:
* **Job Summary:**

We are hiring a In\-Process QA Engineer to join our quality assurance team in a fast\-paced automotive manufacturing environment. This is an entry\-level position ideal for recent graduates or candidates with 0–2 years of experience who are eager to learn and grow in quality systems, process inspection, and automotive standards. As part of the in\-process QA team, you will assist in conducting inspections, identifying quality deviations, and ensuring adherence to production and quality standards throughout the manufacturing process.

* **Key Responsibilities:**

1\. line and final inspections during production processes under supervision.

2\. Monitor and document product quality based on work instructions and control plans.

3\. Assist in identifying and reporting non\-conformities to the senior QA staff or production leads.

4\. Support containment and rework activities for non\-conforming materials.

5\. Maintain inspection records, quality logs, and relevant documentation accurately.

6\. Follow SOPs, safety guidelines, and company quality procedures.

7\. Participate in basic root cause analysis and corrective action activities.

8\. Assist in preparing reports for internal quality audits and customer complaints.

9\. Collaborate with the production team to improve process compliance and product quality

* **Qualifications:**

1\. Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Automobile / Production / Industrial Engineering

2\. 0–2 years of experience in a QA/QC or inspection role (internships or apprenticeships acceptable)

3\. Basic understanding of quality standards in automotive manufacturing (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 preferred)

4\. Familiarity with measurement tools such as vernier calipers, micrometers, plug gauges, etc.

5\. Willingness to work in a shift\-based and shop\-floor environment

6\. Good communication skills and attention to detail

7\. Eagerness to learn and grow within a structured quality management system Preferred

* **Skills (Nice to Have):**

1\. Exposure to tools like FMEA, Control Plans, PPAP, SPC

2\. Knowledge of basic problem\-solving tools (5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram)

3\. Internship experience in an automotive or manufacturing setting

* **What We Offer:**

1\. Structured on\-the\-job training and mentorship

2\. Career development and certification opportunities

3\. Safe and inclusive work environment with a focus on continuous improvement

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹350,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Webflow developer
description:
Webflow Developer
 



 Full\-Time · Remote · Immediate Start · ₹30,000/month
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 TabTech is a lean, fast\-moving branding and design agency serving funded startups and B2B businesses. We help Pressure\-Cooker Founders — post\-seed operators under real pressure — avoid brand disasters and ship enterprise\-grade design at startup speed and budget.
 



  





 We're looking for a No\-Code Developer who can move fast, build clean, and never complain about timelines. If you live in Webflow and Shopify, know JavaScript well enough to bend no\-code to your will, and get genuinely excited about AI\-assisted development — this role was written for you.
 



  





 You'll be working directly on client projects from day one. No hand\-holding. No long ramp\-ups. Just real work, real clients, and real ownership.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





 → Build and ship Webflow sites with pixel\-perfect accuracy, responsive layouts, and clean CMS architecture
 



  





 → Own Shopify store maintenance end\-to\-end — app management, theme updates, product/collection setup, bug fixes, and keeping stores running smoothly for clients
 



  





 → Use prompt engineering to handle Shopify customizations that would otherwise need deep Liquid knowledge — generating, debugging, and adapting code with AI tools confidently
 



  





 → Write JavaScript to extend and customize no\-code tools beyond their default capabilities
 



  





 → Collaborate directly with designers to implement brand systems and design specifications
 



  





 → Manage multiple client projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or timelines
 



  





 → Own post\-launch support, QA, and iterative improvements based on client feedback
 



  





**MUST\-HAVES** 




  





 → Fresher or up to 1 year of experience — we care about what you've built, not how long you've been doing it
 



  





 → Hands\-on experience with Webflow — CMS, interactions, and custom code injections (personal projects, freelance work, or coursework all count)
 



  





 → Shopify store management familiarity — app installs/configs, theme edits, product management, and store operations
 



  





 → Strong prompt engineering skills — you know how to use AI tools to generate and debug Liquid snippets, write custom JavaScript, and solve edge cases without being a Liquid expert yourself
 



  





 → Solid JavaScript fundamentals — DOM manipulation, async/await, APIs, and the ability to debug your own code
 



  





 → Proven use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as a core part of your workflow — not occasionally, but habitually
 



  





 → Ability to read a design file and ship it accurately — no "close enough" mentality
 



  





 → Self\-starter who manages their own time, flags blockers early, and doesn't wait to be chased
 



  





**GOOD TO HAVE** 




  





 → Basic Liquid knowledge — not required, but a plus for when AI\-generated code needs a human sanity check
 



  





 → Experience with Framer — bonus if you've shipped production sites
 



  





 → Familiarity with Supabase, FlutterFlow, or other no\-code/low\-code tools
 



  





 → Basic understanding of SEO, Core Web Vitals, and page performance
 



  





 → CRM integrations (HubSpot, Mailchimp, etc.) → Any exposure to design tools — Figma comfort goes a long way
 



  





**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 → Agency\-minded — you understand that client work is service work, and quality is non\-negotiable
 



  





 → Hungry to learn — you're actively exploring new tools, new AI workflows, and pushing the limits of no\-code
 



  





 → Communicator — you give clear updates, ask the right questions, and never go silent when things get hard
 



  





 → Problem\-solver first — when something doesn't work, you figure it out before escalating
 



  





 → Proud of your craft — sloppy output isn't in your vocabulary
 



  





**WHAT YOU GET** 




 → ₹30,000/month fixed compensation
 



  





 → Work directly with the founder on real client projects — no busywork, no filler tasks
 



  





 → Exposure to a diverse range of projects: funded startups, B2B brands, enterprise clients
 



  





 → A culture that values speed, quality, and learning — not politics or meetings
 



  





 → Room to grow into a senior technical role as TabTech scales
 



  





 → Flexible remote setup with a team that respects your time and delivers on its promises

title: Technical Support for National Health Research Priority Project
description:
EQUIP\-HWC (Equitable, Quality Universal health coverage Implementation research Project for optimizing comprehensive primary health care through Health and Wellness Centres) is a multi\-site implementation research and a national health priority project funded by ICMR (Indian Council of Medical Research) and Gates Foundation being conducted in Salumber district, Rajasthan, in collaboration with the district health department. This implementation research project focuses on developing a successful model to deliver 12 comprehensive primary healthcare (CPHC) services through the public health system across all health and wellness centers by emphasizing quality, equity and core values. This project will be undertaken by the Centre for Healthcare at IIM Udaipur in collaboration with Basic Healthcare Services.



Indian Institute of Management Udaipur (IIM Udaipur) is one of the fastest\-growing management schools in the country. It has already achieved Global Rankings and Accreditation that have put it alongside or ahead of many B\-Schools established much earlier. Taking the legacy of older IIMs forward, IIMU aspires to set new benchmarks in the field of management education by combining excellence in both teaching and research. Research led centre at IIMU, Centre for Healthcare, was conceptualized in the early 2020 to fill the gap of rigorous healthcare research in India on Indian context from the management lens. Its objective is to bring together academicians from management, public health, practitioners, and research active medical professionals to understand and solve fundamental issues in healthcare in low and middle\-income countries (LMIC).



Basic Healthcare Services is a not\-for\-profit organization that provides primary healthcare services in tribal\-rural belt of Udaipur and Salumber districts. It reaches the most vulnerable communities through a network of responsive primary healthcare centres called AMRIT clinics. BHS offers a continuum of preventive, promotive, and curative care while using a combination of innovations in human resources and technology. BHS is one of the leading voices on primary healthcare in India and extensively documents and writes on issues related to healthcare of the marginalized populations in lay press and scientific journals.


#### **Qualifications**



Professionals with MBBS/BAMS/BHMS or MPH/Healthcare Management/PG Diploma or Masters in Anthropology/ Social Work/ Sociology /other social sciences or graduates in Nursing/ Dental Sciences.


#### **Essential attributes**


* Working knowledge of computers, MS office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, e\-mail)
* The project implementation area is Salumber district, Rajasthan. The selected candidates will have to stay in the field area in Salumber district for the entire duration of the project
* Good command over English and Hindi languages.

#### **Desired attributes**


* Excellent written and communications skills, interpersonal skills, organizational and networking skills.
* Previous experience in data collection activities, preferably in public health.
* Good understanding of public health system \& national health programs

#### **Core Responsibilities**


* Conduct data collection as per project protocol,
* Ensure data quality assurance through regular checks and validation,
* Report daily field activities and progress to the project team,
* Engage with stakeholders and community to provide inputs on the ground situation.

#### **Consolidated remuneration per month**


* Rs 31,000 for freshers with increment depending on the relevant years of experience and qualification.

#### **Benefits**



IIMU is a research\-intensive institution. For those who want to embark on their PhD journey, there are benefits of working with us:


* Get first\-hand research experience before pursuing the PhD course,
* Hand\-on experience of working with rural communities,
* Get individualized guidance on building profile and developing individual ideas towards research papers (strengthens the Ph.D. applications),
* Recommendation letters as well as guidance on the application process to top PhD programs in Public Health/ Health management.


Working with Basic Healthcare Services will have the opportunity to:


* Gain hand\-on experience of working with rural communities

#### **Duration**



This job contract will be for 12 months, renewable for additional terms based on satisfactory performance and project resources.


#### **Please note:**



All applications will be reviewed, and those shortlisted will be contacted and invited for an interview remotely (online).

title: Linux Administrator
description:
* Linux administrators are IT professionals responsible for installing, configuring, maintaining, and securing Linux\-based servers and operating systems. Key responsibilities include ensuring system uptime, monitoring performance, performing troubleshooting, automating tasks via scripting, managing user accounts, and implementing security measures like patching and firewall management.
* Core Responsibilities
* System Installation \& Configuration: Setting up new servers, configuring network services, and managing hardware/software components.
* System Security \& Hardening: Applying security patches, configuring firewalls (IPTables), managing SSH, and conducting vulnerability assessments to protect against attacks.
* Performance Monitoring \& Tuning: Using monitoring tools to track server health (CPU, memory, disk space) and optimizing system performance.
* Automation \& Scripting: Utilizing shell scripting (Bash, Perl, Python) to automate routine tasks like log cleanup, backups, and deployments.
* Backup \& Disaster Recovery: Scheduling, managing, and verifying backups, and ensuring swift recovery.
* Troubleshooting \& Support: Diagnosing system failures, performance issues, and user issues.
* User \& Resource Management: Managing user accounts, groups, and permissions, as well as managing file systems and disk space.
* Skills and Requirements
* Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in Linux distributions (e.g., RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian) and tools.
* Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols, command\-line interfaces, and scripting.
* Collaboration: Working with developers and other IT team members to support infrastructure.
* Experience: 2\-5\+ years of experience is typical, with a focus on high\-availability environments.

**3\. Advanced Security \& Risk Management** 
  
 


* **Edge Security (SASE):** 
  Implement and manage 
 **Secure Access Service Edge** 
  and Next\-Gen Firewalls (NGFW) for distributed work environments.
* **Policy Management:** 
  Regularly audit firewall rules to identify and fix vulnerabilities or "bloat" in policy sets.
* **Network Segmentation:** 
  Execute micro\-segmentation strategies to isolate critical banking assets and reduce the lateral movement of threats.
* **Threat Response:** 
  Real\-time monitoring for unauthorized access, malware, and DDoS attacks with a rapid incident response framework.



**4\. Technical Operations \& Troubleshooting** 
  
 


* **Level 3 Troubleshooting:** 
  Rapidly resolve complex connectivity issues, routing loops, and service failures.
* **Project Delivery:** 
  Lead network configurations for new builds, site migrations, and infrastructure improvements.
* **Analytical Reporting:** 
  Deliver monthly metrics on 
 **Network Availability, Change Success Rate, and Incident/Problem Management.**



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 


* **Performance Optimization:** 
  Use telemetry and monitoring tools to ensure network speed and low latency for banking applications.
* **Automation:** 
  Introduce automation for routine configuration backups and patch deployments.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** 
  Work with the Security Operations Center (SOC) to align network policies with threat intelligence.



  
 



**Candidate Requirements** 
  
 


* **Experience:** 
  4 years in Network Operations or Network Security, ideally within the Financial Services sector.
* **Certifications:** 
  CCNP/CCIE (Enterprise or Security), PCNSE (Palo Alto), or equivalent SD\-WAN certifications.
* **Technical Stack:** 
  Deep knowledge of BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPN (IPsec/SSL), and SASE frameworks.
* **Soft Skills:** 
  Ability to remain calm during high\-pressure network outages and communicate technical roots to non\-technical leadership.

title: Sourcing Manager – Grape Labour
description:
**About Bharat Intelligence**

Bharat Intelligence is building India’s first AI\-powered Rural Labour Operating System — organising agricultural labour into a structured, reliable, and dignified workforce.

We operate deeply in Maharashtra’s horticulture belts, starting with grapes in Nashik, where labour availability and quality directly determine farmer income and export outcomes. Our platform predicts labour demand, deploys trained teams, and guarantees execution on the ground.

**Role Overview**

Sourcing Manager – Grape Labour will own the entire labour supply function for the grape category in Nashik.

This is a full\-ownership role, responsible for ensuring that the right quality and quantity of grape\-skilled labour is available, on time, across seasons — with zero dependency on ad\-hoc contractors or informal systems.

You will report to the Head of Supply (HQ) and act as the single point of accountability for grape labour supply across Nashik, the surrounding tribal belt, and feeder corridors across Maharashtra and other grape\-labour regions in India.

This is a managerial \+ execution leadership role with clear outcome ownership.

**What You Will Own** 

1\. Labour Supply Outcomes

* Build and maintain a reliable, scalable pool of grape\-skilled labour (individual workers \+ contractors).
* Ensure peak\-season fulfilment for all grape operations: pruning, training, spraying, harvesting, packing, and ancillary work.
* Be directly accountable for availability, reliability, and quality of labour on the ground.

2\. Sourcing Strategy \& Expansion

Design and execute sourcing across:

* Nashik grape clusters
* Tribal belts (Surgana, Peth, Trimbakeshwar, etc.)
* Other Maharashtra and pan\-India grape labour corridors

Identify, onboard, and manage:

* Labour leaders / mukadams
* Contractors
* Community anchors (SHGs, NGOs, village influencers)
* Reduce over\-dependence on any single corridor or supplier.

3\. Workforce Quality \& Readiness

Own worker vetting, onboarding, and classification:

* Skill mapping (by grape activity)
* Reliability history
* Deployment readiness

Coordinate with training partners to:

* Upskill workers
* Standardise grape\-specific SOPs
* Segregate labour by quality tiers (not all labour is equal)

4\. Field Team Leadership

* Build and manage a field sourcing team (cluster managers, field executives).
* Set clear targets, territories, and accountability.
* Ensure systematic village mapping, worker meetings, and conversion tracking.

5\. Planning with HQ

Work closely with HQ product, ops, and planning teams to:

* Translate seasonal demand forecasts into sourcing plans
* Lock capacity ahead of peak periods
* Prevent last\-minute firefighting
* Flag risks early and solve them before they hit farmers.

6\. Metrics \& Continuous Improvement

You will own KPIs such as:

* Active labour pool size
* Fulfilment rate
* No\-show rate
* Worker repeat rate
* Cost per worker acquisition
* Labour NPS / farmer feedback

You are expected to run experiments, kill what doesn’t work, and double down on what does.

7\. Compliance \& Ethics

* Ensure adherence to labour laws, wage norms, safety standards, and documentation.
* Maintain a zero\-tolerance approach to unsafe, unethical, or non\-compliant practices.

Ideal Profile

* Senior Manager – Partner Onboarding \- 0–2 years of experience in sourcing / field sales / field operations / community mobilisation / business development in rural or semi\-urban areas.
* Sourcing manager \- 0–2 years of experience in sourcing / field sales / field operations / community mobilisation / business development in rural or semi\-urban areas.
* Labour supply / sourcing
* Marketplace supply ops
* Rural operations
* Agri\-ops / logistics / gig workforce management
* Strong exposure to field\-heavy, unstructured environments.
* Proven ability to build and manage on\-ground networks at scale.
* Comfortable being accountable for outcomes — not just activity.
* Understands (or is willing to deeply learn) grape cultivation cycles and seasonality.
* Strong people leadership skills; can handle contractors, labour leaders, farmers, and internal teams.
* Data\-literate: comfortable tracking KPIs and making operational decisions from them.
* Fluent in Marathi and Hindi; English working proficiency preferred.

**Why This Role Matters**

This role directly determines whether Bharat Intelligence can guarantee execution — which is our moat.

If labour supply breaks, nothing else matters. You are building the backbone of the grape labour ecosystem in Maharashtra.

**Why Join Us** 

* Competitive Salary \+ Performance Incentives
* Run the Market: Be the person who makes India’s grape labour OS run in Nashik, owning the full supply charter for the region.
* Impact at Scale: Directly improve livelihoods of thousands of farmers and labourers in one of India’s most important horticulture belts.
* Leadership Seat: Senior, high\-autonomy role with clear visibility to founders and a path to State / Regional Head as we scale.
* Cross\-Disciplinary: Work with AI, product, supply, and operations teams to build the future of agricultural execution in India.

**How to Apply** 

Email your CV along with a short note to animesh.dudwadkar@bharatintelligence.ai

title: QA Supervisor
description:
Position Title: QA Supervisor

Department: Quality Assurance

Location: Kelawade,Bhor,Pune

Reports to: Quality Assurance Manager

Job Overview: The QA Supervisor in the automotive industry is responsible for overseeing the quality assurance processes within the manufacturing facility, particularly focusing on automotive dials, printing, and molding. This role ensures that all products meet stringent quality standards and regulatory compliance, leading and managing a team of QA technicians to monitor production processes and make necessary adjustments.

Key Responsibilities:

1\)Quality Control Management: o Supervise and lead the QA team to ensure that all products (automotive dials, and molded components) meet internal and external quality standards. o Develop, implement, and maintain quality control processes to detect defects at various stages of production. o Ensure that all products adhere to industry standards, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.

2\) Inspection \& Testing: o Conduct routine inspections of raw materials, production processes, and final products. o Coordinate and monitor tests on dials, molded parts to ensure they meet durability, appearance, and functional requirements. o Work closely with the production team to identify quality issues and resolve them proactively.

3\) Documentation and Reporting: o Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of inspections, tests, and corrective actions. o Prepare detailed reports on quality performance, including trends in defects, customer complaints, and supplier performance. o Collaborate with the R\&D team to ensure quality control procedures align with design and development stages.

4\) Team Leadership: o Manage, mentor, and train QA staff, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge to perform their duties effectively. o Conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing feedback to the QA team. o Foster a culture of continuous improvement and a strong commitment to quality within the team.

5\) Continuous Improvement: o Analyze defect data and production results to implement corrective actions or process improvements. o Collaborate with other departments such as Production, Engineering, and Maintenance to ensure optimal quality control practices are followed. o Lead or participate in root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations.

6\) Customer and Supplier Interaction: o Communicate quality concerns to suppliers and assist with the resolution of any supplier\-related quality issues. o Address customer feedback regarding product quality, ensuring timely investigation and resolution.

7\) Compliance \& Audits: o Ensure compliance with IATF standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality policies. o Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards within the QA processes.

Required Qualifications:

1\) Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

2\) Experience: Minimum of 1\-3 years of experience in a quality assurance role within the automotive industry or similar manufacturing environment. (preferably with automotive dials, printing, and molding processes). Proven leadership experience in managing teams and improving quality control procedures.

3\) Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of quality management systems (QMS), quality inspection tools, and techniques. o Familiarity with automotive industry standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 9001, IATF 16949, etc.). o Hands\-on experience with quality inspection equipment (calipers, gauges, CMM, etc.). o Understanding of molding, printing, and automotive dial manufacturing processes.

Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.

Ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, suppliers, and customers.

Leadership qualities and the ability to motivate and guide a team.

title: Senior Credit Controller
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Credit Controller is responsible for managing the complete accounts receivable and credit control function for project\-based home automation and ELV installations. The role ensures accurate project\-wise billing, timely raising of running bills, compliance with e\-invoicing regulations, effective collections, and strong cash flow management aligned with project milestones and contractual terms.

Key Responsibilities1\. Project\-Based Billing \& Invoicing

* Raise **running bills (RA bills)** based on project progress and certified work completion.
* Manage **project\-wise billing** including advance, milestone, variation, and final invoices.
* Prepare invoices as per BOQ, contract terms, and approved change orders.
* Ensure proper documentation (POs, delivery notes, work completion certificates) prior to billing.
* Track retention amounts and ensure timely invoicing and follow\-up for release.
* Process and monitor **e\-invoicing** in compliance with statutory regulations.
* Ensure invoice accuracy to avoid rejection in client portals or government systems.

2\. Accounts Receivable Management

* Monitor customer aging reports on a project\-by\-project basis.
* Ensure timely allocation of receipts and reconciliation of customer accounts.
* Maintain accurate records of billing, collections, and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with project managers to validate billing status and certification.

3\. Credit Control \& Risk Management

* Review customer creditworthiness and set credit limits.
* Monitor credit exposure across ongoing projects.
* Recommend advance payment structures or credit risk mitigation strategies.
* Identify potential bad debts and initiate corrective actions early.

4\. Collections \& Follow\-Up

* Follow up on overdue running bills and milestone invoices.
* Conduct regular meetings with project managers and sales teams to align collection strategies.
* Negotiate payment schedules where necessary.
* Escalate long\-outstanding accounts to senior management or legal where required.

5\. Reconciliation \& Dispute Resolution

* Perform customer account reconciliations regularly.
* Resolve disputes related to variations, scope changes, retention, and certifications.
* Coordinate with technical and operations teams to close billing\-related discrepancies.

6\. Reporting \& Cash Flow Forecasting

* Prepare weekly/monthly AR aging reports and DSO analysis.
* Provide project\-wise collection forecasts aligned with billing schedules.
* Report overdue accounts and cash inflow projections to management.

7\. Compliance \& Audit

* Ensure compliance with company credit policies and contractual payment terms.
* Maintain proper documentation for audit and financial reporting.
* Ensure adherence to statutory e\-invoicing and tax requirements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely raising of running bills
* Project\-wise billing accuracy
* Reduction in Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
* Percentage of overdue receivables reduced
* Compliance with e\-invoicing regulations
* Reduction in invoice rejections/disputes

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
* 5–10 years of experience in AR/Credit Control in project\-based industries (Home Automation, ELV, Construction, MEP, or Contracting).
* Strong knowledge of running bills (RA billing), retention handling, and project accounting.
* Experience in e\-invoicing platforms and ERP systems.
* Advanced Excel skills.

title: Client Enablement and Technical Documentation Writer
description:
**About Us**
 Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.
   

  

 We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions —so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike.
   

  

 Backed by $100M from top investors, we’re tackling big challenges in an industry that’s ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data that can support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it’s why we are leading the way.
   

  

 Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
 **Client Enablement and Technical Documentation Writer** 
 to mature the development and execution of technical and client enablement documentation for our industry\-leading solutions. In this position you will help mature Abacus' internal and external documentation and client enablement processes and deliver easy to consume, accessible, and timely documentation. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience applying modern software product documentation best practices and demonstrate passion for the craft of technical writing. The candidate must demonstrate ability to articulate complex technical concepts through clear, accurate, and comprehensive documentation artifacts.
   

  

 Experience writing for target audiences in the US Healthcare Payer, Healthcare Technology, and/or Healthcare Interoperability market segments is required. This role will work in close partnership with Technical Documentation and Enablement Peers, Product Management, Development, Sales and Client Success stakeholders to ensure that Abacus documentation keeps up with the growing maturity of its solutions and effectively communicates the value of latest features and services.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Mature the development and implementation of Abacus’ client enablement strategy to make product documentation a key support resource for internal and external clients.
* Drive efficiencies in the client enablement process that ensures timely delivery of documentation artifacts by a well\-known process with minimal distractions to other teams.
* Create and maintain effective product documentation backlog that takes into consideration stakeholder tactical needs while staying aligned with the product delivery.

title: HR Generalist
description:
Saviynt is seeking HR Generalist to join the HR Shared Services team, supporting employees and
 



 managers globally with a strong service\-oriented mindset. This role is responsible for delivering operational
 



 excellence across the full employee lifecycle (hire\-to\-retire) while ensuring consistent, compliant, and high\-
 



 quality employee experience across regions.
 



 While the role supports the organization globally, it requires deep expertise in managing the EMEA hire\-to\-
 



 retire process, including onboarding, employee lifecycle changes, payroll coordination, compliance, and
 



 resignation/termination processes.
 



 The ideal candidate is a seasoned HR professional who thrives in a centralized shared services model, operates
 



 independently, manages high volumes of transactions with accuracy, and demonstrates strong knowledge of
 



 EMEA employment regulations and practices.
 




  




**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING** 
* HR Shared Services – Global Support\-


*  Serve as a key member of the HR Shared Services team, delivering Tier 1 and Tier 2 HR operational
* support to employees and managers globally
*  Ensure standardized, scalable, and compliant HR processes across regions
*  Provide consistent guidance aligned with company policies and regional employment laws
*  Partners closely with HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Benefits, Immigration, IT, and
* regional stakeholders


* Employee Lifecycle Management\-


*  Independently process EMEA lifecycle transactions including promotions, transfers, compensation
* changes, leave administration, and organizational changes
*  Ensure transactions are compliant with country\-specific employment regulations
*  Maintain accurate documentation in accordance with local labor laws and GDPR requirements
*  Provide guidance to managers regarding probation periods, working time regulations, statutory leave,
* and other regional practices
*  Manage EMEA resignation and termination processes in compliance with country\-specific notice
* periods, statutory requirements, and final settlement obligations
*  Coordinate final pay calculations, accrued leave payouts, benefits termination, and required
* documentation
*  Partner with Payroll and Finance to ensure accurate final settlements
*  Conduct and document exit processes, ensuring compliance and system access removal


* HRIS \& Data Management\-


*  Own the accuracy and integrity of employee data within the HRIS for Global populations
*  Process and audit employee data changes across regions to ensure accuracy and compliance
*  Generate recurring and ad hoc reports supporting global HR operations, Finance, and leadership
*  Identify trends or data discrepancies and recommend process improvements to enhance operational
* efficiency across regions


* HR Helpdesk \& Tier 1–2 Support\-


*  Serve as the primary HR contact for employees via Slack and ticketing systems regarding payroll,
* benefits, policies, and lifecycle changes across the organization
*  Maintain accurate documentation of inquiries and resolutions within the HR ticketing system
*  Escalate complex regulatory or cross\-border matters as appropriate
*  Maintain audit\-ready documentation across regions



  




**WHAT YOU BRING** 
*  5\+ years of progressive HR Generalist experience in a global organization
*  Direct, hands\-on experience managing:
*  EMEA new hire onboarding
*  EMEA employee lifecycle transactions
*  EMEA labor laws and employment regulations
*  EMEA resignation and termination processes
*  Experience working with multi\-country payroll vendors
*  Strong understanding of GDPR and regional data privacy requirements
*  Ability to collaborate effectively across time zones

*  Excellent problem\-solving skills and independent judgment

 will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation,
 



 gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Deputy Manager, Global People Services (GPS)
company: Hitachi Consulting ( formerly Information Management Group)
description:
**Our Company**
 We’re Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We’re crucial to the company’s strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.
   

  

 Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
   

  

 Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don’t expect you to ‘fit’ every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Deputy Manager \- HR to lead our end\-to\-end onboarding process and ensure robust HR compliance. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of HR best practices, labor laws, and a genuine passion for creating a positive initial experience for new hires. This role requires an open mind, a willingness to learn, and the ability to adapt to a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Onboarding Management:
+ Oversee and continuously improve the entire new hire onboarding journey, from offer acceptance to successful integration.
+ Develop and implement engaging pre\-boarding activities to ensure a seamless transition for new employees.
+ Coordinate and conduct comprehensive new hire orientations, covering company policies, culture, and benefits.
+ Collaborate with IT, Admin, and other departments to ensure all necessary resources (laptops, access cards, desk setup, etc.) are ready before the new hire's start date.
+ Monitor new hire progress and gather feedback to refine the onboarding process.
+ Develop and maintain onboarding materials, handbooks, and checklists.
+ Track and report on onboarding metrics and effectiveness.

* HR Compliance:
+ Ensure strict adherence to all applicable labor laws, regulations, and company policies (e.g., EPF, ESIC, Gratuity, Minimum Wages Act, POSH, etc.).
+ Stay updated on changes in labor laws and recommend necessary adjustments to HR policies and procedures.
+ Prepare and submit all statutory returns and reports accurately and on time.
+ Conduct regular HR audits to ensure compliance and identify areas for improvement.
+ Assist in handling employee grievances and disciplinary actions in compliance with legal frameworks.
+ Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records, both physical and digital, ensuring confidentiality and compliance.

* HR Process Improvement \& Support:
+ Identify opportunities to streamline and automate HR processes, particularly within onboarding and compliance.
+ Assist in the development and implementation of HR policies and procedures.
+ Provide guidance and support to employees and managers on HR\-related queries, focusing on compliance and onboarding.
+ Act as a key contributor to HR projects and initiatives.
+ Foster a positive and inclusive work environment.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Education: Master's degree in Human Resources, or a related field. An MBA/PGDM in HR is highly preferred.
* Experience: 7\-9 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with a strong focus on onboarding and HR compliance.
* Knowledge \& Skills:
+ Sound knowledge of Indian labor laws and HR statutory compliances is essential.
+ Proven experience in designing and executing effective end\-to\-end onboarding
+ Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
+ Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
+ Proficiency in HRIS/HRM software and MS Office Suite (especially Excel, PowerPoint).
+ Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
+ Problem\-solving attitude with a proactive and results\-oriented approach.
+ Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment.


**About Us**
 We’re a global, 1000\-stong, diverse team of professional experts, promoting and delivering Social Innovation through our One Hitachi initiative (OT x IT x Product) and working on projects that have a real\-world impact. We’re curious, passionate and empowered, blending our legacy of 110 years of innovation with our shaping our future. Here you’re not just another employee; you’re part of a tradition of excellence and a community working towards creating a digital future.
   

  

**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

**How We Look After You**
 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We’re also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We’re always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you’ll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

*We’re proud to say we’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status* 
*or any other protected characteristic.*
